title: Dataplex, Data Catalog and lineage across the estate

videos.script: Quitanda has a few hundred tables now, in buckets and in BigQuery. {{estate}} Three questions come up every week. What do we have, and who owns it? Are the numbers in it sane? And when one is wrong, where did it come from? {{questions}} Dataplex answers the first with a catalog. Every table gets an entry, and an aspect says who owns it and whether it holds personal data. {{catalog}} It answers the second with scans. A profile describes a column. A quality rule judges it, against a threshold. {{scans}} And it answers the third with lineage. Each job reports what it read and what it wrote, and the edges make a graph you can walk. {{lineage}} Then the phone numbers. A policy tag on one column lets the delivery team read them, and nobody else. {{tags}} None of this has an emulator. So you will compute the rules and walk the graph on your laptop, as models, and read the rest from Google's documentation. {{models}}
